meta.title: Track your order
meta.description: Check your visa application's status with your order number and a code sent to your phone.

title: Where's my application?
lead: Enter your order number and the mobile number on the order; we'll text you a code to confirm it's you.

result.expired: This view expired. Verify again to keep following your order.

errors.order_number: Enter the order number exactly as you received it, e.g. MV-26-4F7K2Q

events.PENDING_PAYMENT: You reviewed it and accepted the terms
events.RECEIVED: We received your order and payment
